Class DifferentialDrive

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.drive.DifferentialDrive
public final class DifferentialDrive extends Object
Coordinates two independently controlled motors as a differential drive. The drive only knows the board-independent Motor contract, so a motor may be a PWM motor, a remote RCX motor, or a regulated motor with native or external encoder feedback.

Create one instance during setup and reuse it in the control loop. Commands use signed power values from -100 to 100; positive values run forward and negative values run backward. Values outside that range are clamped.
